# InclinedPlane

> InclinedPlane (formerly Sail Analytics) is a data engineering and AI readiness firm. We modernize enterprise data platforms on the stack clients already have (Microsoft Azure and Fabric, Databricks, AWS, Snowflake), then make the data trusted, contextualized and ready for AI agents. We work with CIOs, CDOs and heads of data at mid-to-large enterprises in the US, UK and Europe, from a delivery base in Bengaluru, India. Offices in the United States and India. Tagline: Data Engineered. Intelligence Deployed.

Only facts that appear on the website belong here. Unverified figures are deliberately left out.

## Context engineering

- [Context engineering, explained](https://inclinedplane.com/context-engineering): context engineering is making business meaning explicit and machine-readable (definitions, relationships, rules, permissions and freshness) for people and AI agents. Covers data modelling, ontology and when you need one, and the layers that fix wrong answers.

## What we do: four capabilities on one path

A recommended order, not a strict sequence. Most organizations work on several at once.

- [Data Engineering and Governance](https://inclinedplane.com/capabilities/data-engineering-governance) (Build): lakehouse and warehouse platforms, pipelines, ERP onboarding and multi-ERP harmonization, legacy modernization, with quality, lineage and access controls built in.
- [Enterprise Context Engineering](https://inclinedplane.com/capabilities/context-engineering) (Contextualize): semantic layers, business metric definitions and enterprise context made explicit and machine-readable, so BI tools and AI agents give answers the business agrees with.
- [AI and Agent Readiness](https://inclinedplane.com/capabilities/ai-agent-readiness) (Enable): data readiness assessments, governed access for agents, evaluations built from real questions, and monitoring after go-live. Accelerated by IncLever.
- [Agentic Analytics and BI](https://inclinedplane.com/capabilities/agentic-analytics) (Activate): conversational analytics agents and agentic BI on governed semantic models; answers show their definition, source and freshness.
- [All capabilities](https://inclinedplane.com/capabilities)

## Solutions (accelerators, not a platform pitch)

- [IncLever](https://inclinedplane.com/products/inclever): our data readiness product. Audits, remediates and monitors datasets, semantic layers and metrics so AI agents and BI tools can rely on them. We deliver the work with or without it.
- [PipelineIQ](https://inclinedplane.com/products/pipelineiq): read-only pipeline monitoring, alerting and ETL debugging that groups failures into root causes.
- [Solutions overview, with demos](https://inclinedplane.com/products)

## Start here

- [AI Data Readiness Assessment](https://inclinedplane.com/assessment): a 45-minute assessment of data quality, context, access and governance against what AI agents need.

## Case studies (anonymized)

- [One sales view for 25 to 30 operating companies running five-plus ERPs](https://inclinedplane.com/case-studies/erp-unification): schema-agnostic Azure platform for a FTSE-listed UK industrial group; 15 operating companies onboarded, 80M+ rows per ETL cycle three times a day, 20 dashboards replaced by one report, 2 to 3 weeks to onboard an operating company on a known ERP.
- [Hidden finance logic turned into a governed layer an AI assistant can use](https://inclinedplane.com/case-studies/governed-finance-semantic-layer): evidence-first semantic layer for a listed Indian engineering manufacturer; 20 finance metrics with evidence, 4 blocked rather than guessed, 134 audit rules; IncLever audits the layer and answers only inside it.
- [One lead time across four supply sites](https://inclinedplane.com/case-studies/global-lead-time): one governed Power BI model for the same FTSE-listed group; calendar days and one rulebook, about 85% faster refresh, 107 automated checks.
- [An edible oil producer gets supply and delivery data working as one](https://inclinedplane.com/case-studies/fmcg-edible-oil): SAP, distributor and field-force data unified; 27% faster order fulfillment turnaround, 25% better route adherence.
- [All case studies](https://inclinedplane.com/case-studies): 16 delivered projects across manufacturing, FMCG, energy, logistics, retail, pharmaceuticals and the public sector.
